limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. No Wall--Sun--Sun prime is known, so the persistent automatic branch is conditional on existence. The result corrects and sharpens the square-power witness analysis around Lemma 4.3 of arXiv:2604.17847v3 but does not settle Conjecture 4.4, does not show the lemma's external-prime conclusion false for any known prime, and does not assert an analogous Lucas-sequence theorem. No independent validation is asserted.
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
record_title: Wall--Sun--Sun exceptional branch in Fibonacci-totient residue classes
